entities.name: Starfield Orb
entities.description: Black crystal orb created by Urza as a failsafe to help Teferi fight the Phyrexians; opens a pocket dimension.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Created the Orb and left artifacts hidden on Dominaria.

entities.name: Teferi Akosa
entities.description: Planeswalker who found the Orb while seeking to repair the Zhalfirin time rift.

entities.name: Xantcha
entities.description: Stayed with Urza in a cabin on Gulmany.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother, a construct of whom is in the dimension.

entities.name: Niambi
entities.description: Teferi's daughter who helped him solve the Orb's puzzles.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: Received artifacts from Teferi to build the Temporal Anchor.

entities.name: General Sharaman
entities.description: Spirit imbued with energy by the Orb who interfered with testing.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Entered the Orb's pocket dimension and resolved to share its contents with Teferi.

entities.name: Tivan Desert
entities.description: Site of the monument holding the Orb.

events.summary: Around the Phyrexian Invasion, Urza leaves a series of artifacts hidden on Dominaria.
events.quote: Urza left a series of artifacts hidden on the plane.

events.summary: In 4560 AR Teferi finds the Orb at a monument in the Tivan Desert, solving Urza's puzzles with help from Niambi, the Weatherlight crew and the Gatewatch.
events.quote: Teferi located the Orb in his search for artifacts that might help him repair the Zhalfirin time rift.

events.summary: Two years later Teferi delivers a cache including the Orb to Saheeli Rai for the Temporal Anchor.
events.quote: the Orb was among a cache of artifacts Teferi delivered to Saheeli Rai

events.summary: The Orb imbues General Sharaman's spirit with energy to interfere with the machine's testing.
events.quote: the artifact imbued the spirit of General Sharaman with enough energy to interfere with the machine's testing.

events.summary: Jodah enters the pocket dimension and resolves to share its contents with Teferi.
events.quote: he was able to enter the pocket dimension it contained.

relations.quote: The Starfield Orb is an artifact created by Urza as a failsafe to help Teferi Akosa fight the Phyrexians in case he failed.
with the help of his daughter Niambi
